exactText: 允许将校验脚本上限调整至最多280 KiB。完成修正并通过静态检查和GitHub审查后，复用全部下载文件、零新增下载，在外置硬盘再执行一轮三次依赖还原，总计不超过15分钟，由中央接收结果。继续推进，减少重复记录和会话交接。
sourceScope: Complete the FIX09 NuGet contentHash source correction, its necessary binding and targeted static validation; preserve archive integrity and prior evidence.
nativePrerequisites: Independent GitHub review of the exact source head
priorNativeAttempts: M11 and all earlier attempts remain historical and are not reused.
